 "data": "classDiagram
 class InventoryController {
 +addStock(productId, StockUpdateRequest) InventoryResponse
 +getStock(productId) InventoryResponse
 +getAllStock(page, size, sortBy, orderedBy) Page~InventoryResponse~
 +removeStock(productId, StockUpdateRequest) InventoryResponse
 +setThreshold(productId, ThresholdUpdateRequest) InventoryResponse
 +lowStock() List~InventoryResponse~
 }
 class InventoryService {
 <<interface>>
 +addStock(String productId, StockUpdateRequest) InventoryResponse
 +getStock(String productId) InventoryResponse
 +getAll(page, size, sortBy, orderedBy) Page~InventoryResponse~
 +removeStock(String productId, StockUpdateRequest) InventoryResponse
 +lowStock() List~InventoryResponse~
 +setThreshold(String productId, ThresholdUpdateRequest) InventoryResponse
 +validate(Product, Integer quantity)
 +deductStock(Product, Integer quantity)
 +addStock(Product, Integer quantity)
 }
 class InventoryServiceImpl {
 -InventoryRepository inventoryRepository
 }
 class InventoryRepository {
 <<interface>>
 +findByProduct_ProductId(String) Optional~Inventory~
 +findByActiveTrueAndAvailableQuantityLessThanEqual(int) List~Inventory~
 }
 class Inventory {
 +Long id
 +String inventoryId
 +Product product
 +Integer availableQuantity
 +Integer lowStockThreshold
 +Boolean active
 +Long version
 }
 class QuantityOutOfBoundException {
 <<exception>>
 }

 InventoryController --> InventoryService : ADMIN-only (class-level @PreAuthorize)
 InventoryService <|.. InventoryServiceImpl
 InventoryServiceImpl --> InventoryRepository
 InventoryRepository --> Inventory
 InventoryServiceImpl ..> QuantityOutOfBoundException : throws",
